Citymaker.Recipe.RestArea.Description: A roadside stop: car park, amenity court with restrooms and vending, picnic grove, dog walk and viewpoint.
Citymaker.RestArea.Name: Rest area
Citymaker.RestArea.style.Tooltip: What kind of stop this is. Each type adds its own signature: fuel island, charging lounge, viewpoint…
Citymaker.RestArea.lotShare.Tooltip: Share of the area used for the car park at the main entrance. 0 = no car park.
Citymaker.RestArea.groups.Tooltip: Picnic table groups along the footpath.
Citymaker.RestArea.lotGreen.Tooltip: Planting in the car park: none, along its edges, or in medians between rows.
Citymaker.RestArea.truckBays.Tooltip: Long, wide stalls and wider aisles for trucks and coaches.
Citymaker.RestArea.evShare.Tooltip: Share of the stalls with a charger.
Citymaker.RestArea.hubSize.Tooltip: Width of the paved amenity court where people step out of the car.
Citymaker.RestArea.vending.Tooltip: Vending machines along the back of the court.
Citymaker.RestArea.fuelPumps.Tooltip: A fuel island on the car park side of the court (decorative props).
Citymaker.RestArea.signs.Tooltip: A map / information board at the walk-in point.
Citymaker.RestArea.grills.Tooltip: A grill or fire pit at each picnic spot.
Citymaker.RestArea.dogRun.Tooltip: A small fenced dog run off a branch path, with a bin and a bench.
Citymaker.RestArea.viewpoint.Tooltip: A lookout with a bench arc at the far end of the path.
Citymaker.RestArea.moundHeight.Tooltip: Raise the viewpoint on a mound blended into the ground (permanent terrain change).
Citymaker.RestArea.screen.Tooltip: A belt of trees along the outline that screens the stop from the road.
Citymaker.Transport.Issue.NoLot: No room for a car park here; the stop is planned without one.
